data.narrative:
Portal Biotech is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Andy Heron and Giovanni Maglia that has raised $35M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public Biotech & Health peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies in the sector, though tight filtering constraints limited the applicability of certain methods.

Stage-Progression methodology is the primary applicable approach, using the $35M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to later stages. This yields an implied valuation of $70M. Peer-Median triangulation proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow peers meeting same-stage or adjacent-stage criteria within comparable valuation tiers—the broader sector contains 7 biotech peers, but none satisfied the ≥3 datapoint threshold required for robust median analysis. Public-Comp Anchoring is likewise not executable; while the Biotech & Health sector shows a 9.2x median P/S across the three public comps, Portal's revenue is not on file, precluding revenue-multiple application.

Given the single applicable method, the valuation range is supported at $60M–$80M, centered on $70M. Key uncertainties include Portal's actual revenue trajectory and burn rate, neither available in current data, as well as the representativeness of the 2.0x Series A multiplier to Portal's specific risk profile and capital efficiency relative to peer cohorts.
